svg.title: Autopilot (beta): Dry run, Ask first, Autopilot
svg.desc: The Nilbox Autopilot tab, marked Beta, open on the template routine Fix Dependabot security failures, switched on in Ask first. Watch: pull requests by Dependabot in your account and acme-org. When: checks fail, once every check has finished. If: a failed check's name contains security, codeql, govulncheck, gitleaks, nancy, or osv. Then: run a coding agent with the Fix dep security prompt in the background, inside a fence of $3.00, 30 minutes, and Edit, test, and push to the PR's branch; wait for the checks only if it pushed; and tell you how it went. Test says 3 of 7 open pull requests match now and shows why. Beside it, the routine's modes in order: Dry run records what it would do and does nothing else; Ask first has each match wait for your Run under Needs you; Autopilot runs every step at once within your limits, and its fix is followed to a verdict such as Fixed. Pause Autopilot stops every new start at once. Above, Describe it: tell Autopilot what you want in your own words, and Claude proposes cards you test and apply.

g.text: A routine watches your items, waits for something to happen, and acts within your limits.
Test it on your items, then let it earn your trust: nothing changes its mode but you.
fix it in the background and tell me
Claude proposes cards you test and apply.
Wait until every check has finished
